name: Busa Social
description: Social media command desk: cross-platform monitoring plus an ECHO publishing desk

agentPrompts.label: Summarize what needs my attention
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-social` skill in this folder, then open the overview and summarize the per-platform KPI deltas, this week's top posts, and share-of-voice vs competitors.

agentPrompts.label: Review the post composer queue
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-social` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the pending drafts in the compose queue so I can approve, edit, or block each one — nothing publishes without my approval, and even an approved draft only ever records intent, never a real post.

agentPrompts.label: Review the engagement inbox
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-social` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the incoming mentions and comments with their drafted replies so I can approve or edit each one before it's sent.
